Wow, it's so beautifulll!\nThe scattered white petals glowing in the darkness\nof the night...You gotta pay to see this.
Would you stop being opportunistic for a sec?\nYou're so boorish.\nBut I agree with you saying this view is amazing.
Whoaa?! D-did they just show up suddenly...?!\nAre they the sakura spirits you were talking\nabout?
Ohh, Sherry, Cersier!\nIt's been a while!
Oh, the saviors of the sakura world, I'm so happy\nthat I get to see you guys again.
Celesa, the ruler of the castle in the day region\nof the sakura world also told us to let you know\nthat she said thanks.
Oh, don't mention it.\nWe only did what we thought was right.
Hmm? The ruler of the castle in the day region of\nthe sakura world...? Does that mean that there's\nalso one here in the night region?
Yes, exactly. First, let's go to greet Caylass,\nthe ruler of the Twilight Sakura Castle in this\nnight region of the sakura world...Oh wait?
L-look!
Celesa?!\nOh no, is she the crystal monster who disguised\nherself as Celesa before?!
Don't tell me even Caylass is getting attacked...!
What the hey is wrong with that girl!
Help meeeee!!
What do we do now?!\nWe can't just keep running away like this...!
There's a castle over there!\nLet's go and hide there for now!!
Those rats...Where the hey did they go...
I'll turn them into something nutritious...\nI'll cook, roast, mince, boil, and without eating\nthem, I'll scatter them outside...
W-what the...\nWho's that irascible person?
H-hello, Caylass. Are you all right?\nThose monsters earlier...
I see! They seem to have sneaked into my castle.\nOut of the frying pan into the fire, how pathetic!
T-Tenert, adventurer!\nPlease stop Caylass!
Oh, so you're the adventurer and Tenert that they\nwere talking about before.\nCelesa seems to have troubled you a lot.
By the way, what were those monsters doing?\nDid they attack you too?
Wait, no matter how you look at it, the monsters\nwere the ones getting attacked.
Actually, Celesa told me that you'll be bringing\nsome guests here. But while I was getting ready\nfor that, those rats came.
Well, let's not just stand here.\nWhy don't we go and talk inside my castle?
Okay...But, didn't those monsters just sneak into\nit?
She's right, Caylass! It's dangerous!
Anyway, we'll have to deal with them eventually,\nright? Sooner or later, it's the same, so let's\njust go?
Can I just speak my mind? I think we'll manage it\nas long as we have the adventurer with us.\nRemember how he handled all the monsters before?
Well, I'm fine with it if we have no other\noptions, but it's just that Caylass doesn't know\nhow to go easy on people...
Moreover, even with the adventurer's help, I still\nthink that it would do more harm than good...
Oh, I totally feel you.\nIt's like if you already know you'll still end up\nwith a loss, why bother working hard...
The smell...I can smell it! The smell of rats...\nThey must be somewhere on this floor...
But aren't those monsters quite big?\nI wonder if there's anywhere they can hide here.
Well, they could be hiding behind something.\nLike the hanging scroll or the cabinet for\nexample...
You know what, they aren't bugs.
Fine then. I'll just let them have a taste of my\nsword...
Wait, Caylass!\nThe ruler of a castle should not act impulsively.
T-that's right, Caylass.\nBesides, we don't know what those monster would\ndo.
If you wanna find them, we have Tenert and the\nskillful adventurer here. We should let them do it\ninstead since they're already here...
You guys are wrong.\nI'll never act without thinking.\nI do have a plan.
A plan?
Just leave it to us.
Umm...ummm...\nI-if the enemies are nearby, I'll punch them.\nIf not, I'll go near them and...punch them?
How could you call that a plan...
After all, I still think that it's better to leave\nit to Tenert and the adventurer who had saved the\nsakura world before.
Y-yeah, she's so right!\nWe'll get going then!
I-I'm comin' too! In case we find some valuable\ntreasures, I need to protect them!
Y-yeah! The adventurer is right.\nBesides, we're already experienced with those\nmonsters!
T-that's right!
Alright, c'mon, c'mon...!
I-I'm comin' too! In case we find some valuable\ntreasures, I need to protect them!
I remember that young lady said she could smell\nthem on this floor...\nLet's split up to find them!
They seem to be hiding in the big room...\nEven if it's big, we'll find them eventualy if we\nsearch every corner. Let's split up again!
Alright, we should get going too!\nTo find the treasures...oops, I mean the rats!
Wowow?! What is this room?
W-what?! Are you challenging us?!\nHey, I'll leave this to you!
Oh, so you two are here!
I could feel the monsters' presence so strong just\nnow, but it's becoming weak now...
I think they came out and escaped after you killed\nall of their pawns...Well that was fast.
They must have used their pawns to buy them some\ntime to get away and hide.
The problem is...that power...
If it is actually being absorbed from this castle,\nthen...
Well, anyway, I've no intention of letting that\nhappen. We'll eventually get them if we go after\nthem. Plus, they seem to be still on this floor.
Aight!\nLet's get to work once again then!
...? What's actually going on?
Hmm...anyway, we've got no choice other than to\ntry and catch it, right?
Oh! This time it's here?!
Yeah...but, it's gone.\nI don't feel their presence anymore.
Shoot! They got away again.\nThey're really fast indeed...Oh wait?
I see, they seem to have escaped upstairs.
It's okay, sooner or later, they'll hit a\ndead end~♪
A-anyway, let's head upstairs!
What the hey...how dare they spoil my castle with\nthose weird things!
But, there seems to be more crystals here than\ndownstairs...And they're larger too...
If these crystals continue to proliferate...\nOh gosh, I don't even wanna think about it...
The world here was once a victim and yeah, that\nwould not be nice for sure.
So you made it here...\nBut that's as far as you'll go!
Hey, this is my castle!\nAnd what's with those ugly crystals?\nI hate that kind of color, you know!
Not just the color, personally I think...
You won't be able to break this wall easily!\nSo, just stop chasing us already!
Dream on...I won't let you ruin my castle!
This wall...\nSeems to be made with the energy absorbed by those\ncrystals.
So all we need to do is destroy those crystals,\nright? In that case, leave it to us!\nIt'll be done in no time!
Haha...I can always count on you!\nOh yeah, if you see that thing, lemme know.
Sure! Aight, let's go!
This place is no longer safe. Let's go!
Ooh, this place seems to have been cleared too.
But they managed to get away...\nDid they run upstairs again?
Just think of it as us driving them to a dead end.\nSoon there will be nowhere for them to hide.
H-hey, look!\nThose crystals came back!!
Is it because of the monsters upstairs?
This is bad.\nThat means my sword didn't do any good.
But is it possible to at least clear the miasma?
Hmm...That thing might work.\nI wish it were with me now.
What is it? You know how to deal with this?
Yeah, my fairy sword...oops, I mean perhaps we\ncould cut them off if we have an ancient, sacred\nsword.
Did she just say "fairy sword"?
And if I remember correctly, it's being sealed...\nOops, I mean kept secure deep inside this castle.
Did she just say "sealed"?
Aargh, whatever!\nAnyway, we need a lot of stuff to unseal\nmy fairy sword!
As long as we have the sword, I think we can deal\nwith those monsters, so move your ass and bring it\nto me!!
You need to be polite when asking for help,\nCaylass...
I guess that's our only option for now.\nAdventurer, could you please get us the materials?
Oh well...what about me?
Would you please stay to get rid of the crystals\nand monsters roaming in the castle?
I'll help too.\nThey seem to be supplying power for that creature\nupstairs.
While waiting for the adventurer to return, we\nwant you to weaken the power, even if it's just\na little.
If that's what I should do, fine then...
Oh...also please watch over Caylass, in case she\nscrews up...
What did you say?
Ah, oh, nothing...
All right then, adventurer, would you please?
If we don't do it, we can never enjoy hanami...\nSo what else can we say? We'll do it.
Thank you.
We're counting on you...
That doesn't seem to be enough yet.\nI know you wanna get it done fast, but please,\nI need you to make sure it's perfect.
All right, you seem to have got everything.\nOkay then, take a few steps back.
Wait what?! The fairy sword can't possibly be\nhere, right?
To be precise, this castle is the place it's being\nsealed. Only I can unseal it. Alright, oh scarlet\nsakura fairy sword...come back to me once again!
T-that thing kinda looks dangerous...\nIs it all right to hold something like that with\nyour hand?
It's a sacred item that makes its wielder want to\nblindly slash at things...and in my hand, it gets\nslightly better.
Oh well, this is the Caylass I know.
She's always been this way.\nNot much difference than usual.
Now I finally know what you normally think of me.\nWe need to talk after this.
And of course, it's gonna be a fist-to-face-talk.
W-what's more important is now is that sword is\ngonna fix the situation, right? So, let's hurry!
Yeah, right. That Amalgam thingy must think that\nhe's the ruler of this castle now...\nI'll teach him a lesson immediately!
Oh, Tenert! Also the adventurer...
Yeah, I'm here to inspect this place before\nbringing Libera and Virgo...\nDid anything go wrong?
Umm, err...
Well, it's no big deal. We just touched this\nscarlet sakura fairy sword, but then those\ncreatures merged into one again and revived.
W-w-wait what?!\nWhat a fine mess you've got us into!!
Well, it's because I've known this girl for a long\ntime, and I didn't expect such thing to happen.
Oh, well, I've also been serving you for a long\ntime, Ms.Caylass, and I didn't expect you would\nmake such a mess.
So where did the Amalgam that came back to life\nrun off to?
The top of the castle, I guess.\nBut...
I told ya.\nWe only need to pummel that thing again and\nthey will break apart.
No, Caylass, the fairy sword makes you wanna do\nso!
Tenert may be bringing some friends over to enjoy\nhanami later and we can't just let them sit on\nbloody ground!
I told ya I'm fine!\nYou think I wanna stain this sword with blood or\nbathe in blood? I never thought like that at all!
Guys, I'll deal with this, so can you just go\nand take a look?
I guess we have no choice.\nPlus, this is a request from an important\ncustomer...
All right then! Hey, let's go!
Ooh, I wanted to slash that thing too.\n(Sorry for troubling you again.)
C-Caylass...
Oh, that's not right!\nYou just told them what you really feel.\nYou should learn how to hide it sometimes!
W-what happened to those creatures?
You mean Amalgam?\nThey have been broken apart and they left after\nthat.
Sherry and Cersier protected them from Caylass...\nOops, I mean, they left after Sherry and Cersier\nlet them go.
But even after all those threats,\nthey actually listened and left?
Yeah but after firing brutal parting shots...\nFor example, "You better behave yourself!"...
They also said things like "That girl should be\nlocked away!", "Never come out to this world!",\n"Dangerous girl", and what else...
I get so annoyed thinking about it again...\nAlright, I think they haven't gone far.\nI'll go greet them!
P-please wait...!\nThe adventurers are leaving, so please see them\noff...
Besides, Tenert's friends are coming too later,\nwe need to do some preparations...
Oh well, you guys are right.
Tenert, hurry and go tell your friends.
O-okay, thank you...
What about you guys?
Umm, I think we'll pass this time.\nI'm exhausted after all this...
F-fine then, adventurer...
We look forward to your next visit...
EVENT BATTLE\nDefeat the monster!!
Go after Cerabes!!
EVENT BATTLE\nDestroy all the corroded crystals!!
Go back to Sofya City?
Yes
No
Wow!\nI thought Sakura Castle was already huge, but\nthis one is magnificent too.
Oh, the spirits are visible now!\nOnce again, let us count on ya!
Hey, Virgo! Please watch your attitude and make\nsure you're not being rude in front of the ruler\nof the castle! We're counting on you two.
Hey, look! Someone is sleeping over there, right?
Oh! Isn't that Tenert?!
Oh, no! The other one appears to be unconscious!
Hey, Tenert!\nAre you alright?!
Ouch, ouch, ouch...Keep your voice down! It echoes\nin my head!!
Caylass! What happened?
Blah blah blah, no more punching...
Tenert, can you tell us what happened exactly?
Actually, I was drinking some liqueur that Caylass\noffered...
I thought it was good at first, but then suddenly\nI felt weird...
The sakura liqueur from this world doesn't usually\nmake people sick like that though. Besides...
The fact that Caylass passed out from drinking it\nbothers me. It has never happened before, not\neven once.
This liqueur?\nThe liqueur in the sakura world is drawn from the\nLush Falls though...
But if all of this happened because of the\nliqueur, maybe we should go check the\n"Lush Falls".
Passing out from drinking is a common thing but...\nIf that even happens to Caylass, then something is\nnot quite right here. We need to check it!
If the liqueur is the reason all of this happened,\nwe definitely need to go check it, but...
Why are you so keen on going?
Because it hasn't been easy for me to finally find\nsomething that I may be able to sell, if something\nis wrong with it, how am I supposed to sell it?!
Okay, let's say if we're going to the\n"Lush Falls"...
What about Caylass?
Blah blah blah...\nI won't hurt you if you do as I say...
I'm bothered by her sleep talking...
Is it okay if we leave her?
True...Don't you think she keeps on rambling weird\nstuff?
No big deal. She's weird even when she's awake.
I think she'll wake up when she feels hungry.\nFor now, let's just go to the "Lush Falls"\nfirst...
There shouldn't be any madcap creature...Um, I\nmean insolent creature that would attack Caylass\naround here, right?
We don't wanna wake her up, it's dangerous...\nWe might ruin her mood. For now, let's just go to\nthe "Lush Falls" first...
Blah blah blah...\nI don't really like to fight...\nI only like to hit people...
You're still sleeping...
We need to wake her up.\nCersier, let's do it together...
One, two...
Ah, uh-oh! What? What's going on?\nWho am I? Where's this?\nAnd what's this extreme pain around my cheeks?
Oh, great.\nYou're finally awake.
Huh? What?\nDid I just say something great?
...Also, aren't you the adventurer who helped us\nbefore? Why are you here too?\nWhat's actually going on?
Actually...
The Scarlet Sakura was at the top of the\nwaterfall? How could it be in a place like that\nagain?
Do you know anything about it, Caylass?
Sorry, Caylass. The liqueur we were drinking\ntogether though...Did you also bring it from the\n"Lush Falls"?
Yeah?\nI want my guest to enjoy my hospitality so I\npersonally went to the "Lush Falls"...
I think at that time...I thought the liqueur would\ntaste great at the top of the waterfall...So I\nthink I just hurled the Scarlet Sakura away.
Yeah! Why did you hurl me away? It was your fault!\nAnd how could you even forget about me?!
Uh, um...I forgot about you after drawing the\nliqueur there. But then on my way home, I kept\nthinking why my belongings felt so light...
Do you even have a brain?\nOh, you do, but you're just not using it!!
What did you say?!\nDid you forget that you're just a sword?\nA sword isn't supposed to drink and get drunk!
It was you who tossed me into the liqueur, you\nknow! You're the reason all of this happened.\nDon't you get it?!
Before you go further, stop talking like me!
It's not like I wanna talk like you!\nDon't you know about product liability?!
Stop complaining already or I'm gonna seal you\nagain!! Or do you prefer that I break you apart\nand keep you as nails for the castle repair!
Oh, I'm scared!\nYou're obviously 10 times more dangerous and\ndeserve to be sealed more than me!!
Well, well, cut it out...It's over now, let's just\nforget about it. Since it's hanami, why don't we\njust have another drink to celebrate it?
Y-you're right.\nIt's not fun either if we go on making a fuss.
I-I have no objection!
Alright, let's all just drink again to celebrate\nhanami...
Let's prepare the liqueur again...
Oh, since I seem to have troubled you guys,\nlemme just go get it!\nYou guys stay here.
Don't worry, I'm okay!!\nI'm not drunk anymore!\nI repeat, I'm clean and sober now!!
That's currently the statement that we can trust\nthe least in this world!
Just make sure you don't give us any more trouble!
Sorry, finally things are getting back to normal.\nHere, a token of my apology.
Oh, okay. Thank you.
By the way, didn't you say that you wanted to keep\nsome liqueur from this place?
I changed my mind after all the hullabaloo.\nIf you wanna gift us, please give us something\nelse!
I see. Fine, take this then.
Okay then, let's drink again!\nTenert, you can still drink, right?
As long as it's not bad liqueur, I'll keep you\ncompany! Virgo, Libera, you guys should drink too!
Of course we should! That goes without saying!
Till the morning comes ♪\n...Wait, do they even have morning here?
I'm good. At first I thought I could make some\ncash here, but now...I don't see any reason for me\nto stay here.
Thanks for helping us again this time.
We'll be looking forward to your next visit...
Dear adventurer, I heard you saved the sakura\nworld again...\nThank you.
I'm not sure whether we actually saved it or we\nsimply got involved...\nAnyway, who are you??
She's Celesa, the ruler of the Sakura Castle.\nI'm the ruler of the castle in the night sakura\nworld and she, the one in the day sakura world.
You're Pelulu, right?\nI've heard about you.
Tenert and the others? Oh, they were here before,\nbut they've already left because they said they'd\ngot some work to do.
Busy as always.\nAnyway, where are those little spirits?
You mean Sherry and Cersier?\nThey're with the Scarlet Sakura...
What? With that sword? Why?
She said she wanted to go get some air to sober\nup...And those two just went to accompany her.
They went with her to watch her to be honest. They\nsaid they were going to the top of the waterfall,\nbut...it's been a while. Can you go check them?
Er...well...They should be fine, right?\nI mean it's sorta troublesome and there's no\nreason for me to do it either.
Oh, don't worry.\nI'll prepare some reward for you.
Now we're talking!\nOkay, let's hurry then!
...You seem to have got used to take care of that\nPelulu girl.
Oh, I heard it from those 3 guys.\nThat little girl will move instantly as long as\nyou provide some reward for her.
...I see...
I'm so sorry that this thing was being selfish\nagain.
Caylass, I think it's better if you seal that\nsword...
It's okay, it's okay ♪\nI'm gonna take care of it properly.
Is it really okay...?
But, Caylass is the only one who can handle the\nScarlet Sakura though...
Oh well, they say you need to fight poison with\npoison, right?
Alright, we ended up troubling you again!\nIt's not much, but please take this.
Adventurer, thank you very much for your hard\nwork.
Jeez, I still can't believe that we were made to\nfight a drunken sword...\nNext time we wanna enjoy hanami peacefully.
See you again then, adventurer...
We'll be looking forward to your next visit...
